output.scope_note: The paper is a machine-learning MD study of the Li+ glassy solid electrolyte 30Li2S-25B2S3-45LiI-5P2S5 and reports a computed Li+ ionic conductivity, plus an experimental value cited from prior work.

records.evidence_quote: The calculated Li+ ionic conductivity is 10.36 mS/cm, which is higher than the experimental value of 2.4 mS/cm.
records.notes: Computed in this paper from MACE-FT machine-learning MD (Nernst-Einstein, Eq. 2). The paper does not state the temperature for this conductivity value; the activation energy 0.2241 eV is from the same paper's Arrhenius fit of Li+ diffusivity (300-600 K). Glass composition is the paper's stated focus composition.
